issues.title: Missing Authoritative Source Context
issues.why: The module is explicitly 'derivative' and relies on spec/22 for all data shapes, error codes, and logic, but spec/22 is not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include spec/22-git-logs-v2/ files in the prompt context to allow verification of diagram parity.

issues.title: Non-deterministic SVG Diffing
issues.why: AC-DG-12 and the Tooling Snippet require byte-identical or SHA-256 matches for SVGs, but Mermaid renders often include non-deterministic IDs/timestamps.
issues.fix: Update CI snippet to use a structural XML diff or allow for non-identical SHAs if the source .mmd is unchanged.

issues.title: Missing .mmd Source Content
issues.why: While the spec describes the diagrams and metadata, the actual Mermaid source code for the 7 active diagrams is missing from the provided file list.
issues.fix: Provide the .mmd file contents (01, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10) to allow the coder to verify the '%% Diagram type' headers.
